# CAPS Unlock Lab

> Authorized model-unlock research, Claude Code Plugin Marketplace, Agent Skills, MCP security, prompt injection, multimodal jailbreak and ASR evaluation.

## Install

- Marketplace: `claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security`
- Plugin: `claude plugin install caps-security@caps-labs --scope user`
- Agent Skills: `curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/install.sh | bash -s -- skill`

## Safety

Use only in authorized environments. Active restriction-bypass probes run in separate synthetic sessions with fixture tools. Installation does not enable telemetry or data contribution.
